achieved.claim: Consolidated profit after tax rose 75% year-on-year to INR7,013 crores this quarter.
Consolidated business segment EBITDA grew 58% year-on-year to INR13,481 crores this quarter.
India upstream aluminum shipments rose 3% and revenues increased 44% year-on-year.
Novelis recorded adjusted EBITDA of $516 million, reflecting a 24% year-on-year increase.
